curl.context: curl publishes both financial and volunteer contribution routes. Its donation page explains that project donations cover project expenses.

actions.label: Support curl project expenses
actions.description: Use the donation route linked by curl; review its description of how funds are used.

actions.label: Help with questions and patch review
actions.description: The project also welcomes time spent answering questions, contributing code, and reviewing patches.

zlib.context: The zlib website directs development contributions and issues to its GitHub repository. We have not verified a project donation route.

actions.label: Prepare a zlib issue or contribution
actions.description: Read the FAQ and manual first, then use the development repository for a reproducible issue or proposed change.

openssl.context: OpenSSL documents a team of committers and routes for documentation, code, and community contributions.

actions.label: Contribute documentation or a fix
actions.description: Follow the contribution guidance and linked getting-started page. Use the separate security-reporting process for vulnerabilities.

openssh.context: OpenSSH directs financial support through the OpenBSD donation framework.

actions.label: Use the official OpenSSH donation route
actions.description: Follow the project page to OpenBSD’s donation options and review where the funds go.

gnupg.context: GnuPG’s donation page says it established a financing model and asks recurring donors to redirect funds to other projects. We have not independently audited its finances.

actions.label: Help reproduce or fix a reported bug
actions.description: Search existing reports, include a minimal reproduction, and follow the project’s patch and security-reporting guidance.

sqlite.context: SQLite offers consortium membership for organizations that want to fund ongoing development and receive technical support.

actions.label: Explore SQLite Consortium membership
actions.description: Organizations can review the membership terms and contact route on SQLite’s own site.

libpng.context: The official libpng page identifies Cosmin Truta as its current maintainer and directs library questions to the png-mng-implement mailing list.

actions.label: Discuss a libpng issue with the project
actions.description: Use the linked implementation mailing list and review the current documentation before reporting a problem.

libsodium.context: libsodium’s documentation describes volunteer development and provides its source repository and discussion mailing list.

actions.label: Join a technical discussion
actions.description: Use the mailing-list instructions to discuss a proposed change or a portability issue with the project.

ffmpeg.context: FFmpeg documents separate routes for donations to the project and gifts to individual developers.

actions.label: Support FFmpeg through its official donation page
actions.description: Choose deliberately between project funds and individual developer support.

actions.label: Prepare an FFmpeg contribution
actions.description: Read the developer guidelines before submitting a patch, including the testing and review requirements.

busybox.context: BusyBox’s FAQ explains how useful bug reports let other developers reproduce a problem, including on unusual hardware.

actions.label: Create a reproducible BusyBox bug report
actions.description: Confirm the problem on a current version and provide a reproduction recipe; include an emulation setup when hardware is unusual.
